holdout: root controlled original regular independent holdout; not used by prototypes
core: Full body passes initially open A, a single airborne shot swaps A closed/B open and recoils through B onto destination; no intermediate landing between A and B
v1_geometry_domain: A x270..290; B x550..570, both y130..900; roof bottom130; departure225; receiver220,405; destination begins680 top438. Lower recovery900 below practical one-shot climb; stairs entirely west of entry.

v1_control_domain.aim: original real bell targeting with actual projectile flight

selection: First clean valid control, then mild6/moderate6 on fixed controls. Select maximum minimum rate then earlier index, only before root full calibration. Nominal geometry frozen before counterexamples; original regular gate unchanged.
counter_policy: Real same-goal reward and stable destination, body safety and original resources. Ground early swap, no shot, under/over gates, ground middle toggle, long jump, alternate shot angles. Do not infer no_path from finite failures.
failure_recovery: Lower safe floor and original stationary stairs to entry; repeated pair receiver allows restore A after falling; exact continuous recovery must be separately tested
